Messages.Author: kschaefer
Messages.Body: I know that we, in the US, often cause some troubles, but 09/07/2021 is is September 7th, 2021 and not July 9th, 2021. Would it be possible with legality dates to use a more clear format that works for DD/MM/YYYY and MM/DD/YYYY locales?

Messages.Author: lip
Messages.Body: I second that ☺︎ International standard format (ISO) is unambiguous (2021-07-09). If not plain text would do too (July 9th 2021)
